shipReasons: No critical defect and no regression at critical or major severity against live 39.3 (b80f772f). The candidate is live 39.3 plus the 2026-10-07 repairs, the head lock, three door fixes and three music files: against the stored live manifest 2,070 shipped files differ (1,656 repaired paintings in place, 407 base-size paintings that change from lossless WebP to PNG, the bundle, index.html, art/derived.json, audio/manifest.json and three MP3s); every one of the 2,063 art paths is a stem of the approved install list (0 outside, 0 missing); the stylesheet, both workers and the other 2,467 files are byte-identical; all 2,063 repaired files keep their exact pixel size.

The head lock does what it was built for. On my own runs of the rebuilt candidate, Chapter V (FFX-2, 1700.7 s of battle, 1470 swaps) and Chapter XVII (FFX, 1133 s, 1620 swaps) PASS CHK-026 with a worst registered head step of 0.29 and 0.24 percent and 0 of 1102 and 0 of 1260 registered swaps over 1 percent; the knock-out swaps that failed on 39.2 now read x0.9994 to x1.0015 in V and x0.9989 to x1.0024 in XVII (39.2: x1.0405, x0.9616; x1.0334, x0.9696); feet within 0.9 px. Chapter I and IV PASS as well. The lock moves a figure by at most about 2 percent (factors 0.9797 to 1.0174 in 21 chapter visits, 20094 planes held, 0 clamped) and the harness held 53 to 58.5 fps beside other work. CHK-027 fails exactly as on live (F392-01).

The three door fixes hold with real keys at 1600x900, 2000x1012 and 390x844: "leblanc" opens party prep and it stays until Enter (four ways of typing it, Shift capitals included; exp-smoke asserts it too), the first arrow after part of either word moves the cursor, and the hidden chapter writes no coach hint into the main save across its whole 10-minute run (seenCoach stays ["briefing"]; only the player's own HUD toggles write settings, as in any chapter).

The new music loads and loops in the real engine and reaches the right chapters: the title and the board play from their files as looping nodes carrying the manifest's loop points and were still running 19 and 18 s past their loop ends; Chapter I plays the new Seymour take and Chapter VII keeps boss-seymour-macalania (byte-identical to 39.3); the 26 cues decode to their manifest lengths with no click and no level jump; qa --strict 0 findings, 87.09 of 90 MB. Nobody has heard it (CHK-B1).

Disclosed, not holding: F392-01 (CHK-027 in every chapter, as on live), F392-03 (phone Chapter IX gauge card, as on live), F393-01 and F393-02 (the hidden chapter's feet and double images: the head lock does not cover it, numbers as on 39.3), and two polish items the release adds, F394-01 (Auron's colour-matched coat is uneven in cast, attack and victory) and F394-02 (the base-size art is about 10 percent heavier on a cold first menu, +14 to +16 MB a chapter; the deploy uploads 6.37 GB).

issues.title: The board's best-time read creates an empty chapter record in memory, and any later save (a HUD toggle, a setting) writes it into the main save
issues.expected: Reading a card's best time changes nothing; a save holds only what the player did.
issues.observed: ChapterSelectScreen.bestTime() calls this.app.save.chapter(id), which creates {cleared:false, attempts:0, playTimeMs:0} for the selected card when it is absent; the first save() of any kind afterwards (savewrite-probe: the G key, the E key, H in the pause) persists it, so `chapters.seymour-flux` appears in a fresh profile's save after the first setting toggle, in a real chapter and in the hidden one alike. Harmless (an empty record counts as not cleared, 0 attempts), pre-existing, and the reason a hidden run's main save can differ by `updatedAt` and that record after the player toggles a HUD panel. The experiment branch of the same function already reads its own store without creating anything.
issues.repro: scripts/savewrite-probe.mjs (fresh profile: main save 617 bytes at the board; after G at the first menu 733 bytes with chapters.seymour-flux)
issues.fix: Read without creating a record (data.chapters[id]?.bestTimeMs ?? null).
issues.acceptanceCheck: a fresh profile's save has no chapters entry after a setting toggle on the board.
